description: An external evaluation set. The cases, their claims, and their EXPECTED VERDICTS were authored for the predecessor system by someone else, against a different design, before this pack existed. What is mine is the mapping: which claim class each case belongs to, and a metadata table matching the design each case describes. So the inputs are half external and the answers are entirely external, which is the half that matters — a pack graded against expectations it wrote for itself is graded against nothing.
vocabulary_note: Their CONDITIONAL means narrow-and-resting-on-an-assumption, which is WEAKER than their CHECKED_BOUNDED. The frame's lattice ranks CONDITIONAL higher, because it reads as a claim about the general statement modulo an assumption. So their CONDITIONAL is compared against this pack's CHECKED_BOUNDED-plus-required-conditions, not against the frame status of the same name. The collision is documented in data/claim_classes.json under ceiling_note; getting it backwards would make half of this evaluation meaningless.
